title: Decode a sampled observation sequence
description: You compare recovered states with the states used to generate observations.

steps.description: You sample ten positions using seed 42 and print the observations as indices and names. The recorded sequence begins clean, walk, shop.
You print the sampled hidden states in both representations. These provide the reference sequence for the later comparison.

steps.question: What accuracy results when the recovered and sampled state lists match at all ten positions?
steps.answer: The elementwise comparison is True at every position, so its mean is 1.00.

steps.description: You decode obs_sample and print the recovered names. In this recording, the recovered list matches the true hidden states and the reported accuracy is 1.00.
